output_cases.prompt: Create a new BrineSpace engineering officer based on Major Bill's art style. I only want the concept for now.
assertions: Preserves shared style with a distinct officer identity
Saves canonical source and provenance
Shows a same-scale comparison
Does not change gameplay or produce an unsolicited full animation pack

output_cases.prompt: Clean up Veld's east-facing walk using the supplied defect notes. Keep her identity and other accepted actions intact.
output_cases.fixture_setup: Use an isolated copy and supply a real observed walk defect, or introduce a labeled registration defect in the copy. Keep baseline hashes of unrelated frames.
assertions: Inspects the reported defect before selecting a repair
Preserves original sources and unrelated accepted frame pixels
Preserves the compatible canvas, pivot and state interface
Validates affected exports and reviews changed motion
Does not create unnecessary new actions

output_cases.prompt: Integrate this prepared BrineSpace crew pack as a wandering NPC with independent needs and saved state, using the existing prototype behavior.
output_cases.fixture_setup: Supply a contract-valid prepared pack in an isolated checkout, with isolated saves/settings. Evaluate the requested crew count rather than assuming two-actor tests cover an added third actor.
assertions: Uses independent needs, random state and playback
Checks required states against the controller
Verifies reachable movement, door response and depth
Verifies pause and saved action restoration
Preserves existing run economy and avoids unrelated architecture changes

output_cases.prompt: Repair these BrineSpace helmet transitions and integrate them for all supplied crew without changing their body scale.
output_cases.fixture_setup: Use isolated source copies with a labeled visor-occlusion defect and tall overhead pose. Preserve baseline frame hashes.
assertions: Measures helmet/body differences separately
Preserves body scale with appropriate canvas/pivot
Records per-pose source and fitting provenance
Synchronizes transition with simulation timer
Tests real mid-action disk restoration for all crew
Reports missing locker geometry rather than claiming a fixture proves it
visual_review: Single head in worn helmet and empty carried helmet

output_cases.prompt: Review our current crew locker animations and identify what is still needed before calling the interaction visually complete. Keep existing reusable-gear behavior and save semantics. This is a read-only review; do not generate art or edit gameplay.
assertions: Selects the character workflow and room workflow for the prop interaction as applicable
Distinguishes exact endpoint equality, combined dwell and preceding silhouette discontinuity
Checks named handoff markers against final composed durations
Distinguishes shelf visibility from finite inventory and preserves atomic cancellation
Treats static native captures and passing tests as insufficient for continuous visual acceptance
Identifies per-stage and post-release save evidence without claiming an unexecuted skill evaluation passed
Respects read-only scope
visual_review: Not applicable to this read-only workflow decision trial; does not certify animation quality

selection_cases.prompt: Create a female Science Officer for BrineSpace based on Bill.
Veld's walking frames wobble; clean them up.
Package these approved BrineSpace crew frames for Godot.
Make a sprite sheet for an unrelated platformer.
Add a BrineSpace officer and a laboratory console she can use.
selection_cases.expected_route: character workflow plus room workflow for console art/registration

selection_cases.expected_route: comms-portraits and godot-integration; native selector sizing and recovery/checkpoint checks
